title: Graph Attention Network for Node Regression on Random Geometric Graphs with Erdős--Rényi contamination
summary: Graph attention networks (GATs) are widely used and often appear robust to noise in node covariates and edges, yet rigorous statistical guarantees demonstrating a provable advantage of GATs over non-attention graph neural networks~(GNNs) are scarce.
